title: Chanel's price ladder under a luxury slowdown

claims.text: Observed Chanel list-price ladder contains a high Classic anchor.
claims.scope: FR/US public list prices, 2026-08-15; 41 accepted, 35 numeric observations
claims.boundary: Visible sample gaps do not measure customer migration or complete assortment.

claims.text: Classic median +18.1%, Mini median +16.5%, absolute gap +EUR880.
claims.scope: Selected continuous France lines; common years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2026
claims.boundary: Not every handbag or a US historical series.

claims.text: Chanel declined in FY2024 and recovered partially in FY2025; peer paths differ.
claims.scope: Chanel consolidated / Hermes group / LVMH FLG department / Gucci segment
claims.boundary: Comparable, constant-currency and organic definitions differ; no universal ranking.

claims.text: FY2025 revenue index 97.6 and operating-profit index 73.5, FY2023=100.
claims.boundary: Group recovery, not handbag demand; reported currency retains FX.

claims.text: Asia Pacific represents 90.4% of FY2024 net decline; Europe and Americas offset AP weakness in FY2025.
claims.scope: Chanel reported-USD regional disclosures, rounded USD millions
claims.boundary: Sales region is not customer nationality or product category.

claims.text: Retail recovered 45.7% of its previous-year loss in FY2025.
claims.scope: Chanel consolidated retail channel, reported USD
claims.boundary: Retail is not handbags; geography and channel are parallel decompositions.

claims.text: Operating-profit shortfall of USD1695.5m equals gross-profit loss773.0 plus SG&A rise984.8 minus advertising/distribution savings62.3.
claims.boundary: Accounting identity does not identify investment ROI or causal demand mechanism.

claims.text: Blazy first collection merchandise arrived in March2026, outside FY2025 merchandise sales.
claims.scope: Selected product timing; marketing study window2025-08-13 to2026-08-13
claims.boundary: Earlier halo effects unmeasured; CHANEL25 universal first-sale date unresolved.

claims.text: Public CHANEL25 use accounts and beauty scale offer possible mechanisms.
claims.scope: Purposive unauthenticated self-reports; third-party beauty estimate
claims.boundary: No representative client mix, audited category bridge or contribution ranking.

claims.text: Higher visible handbag price architecture coexisted with partial group revenue recovery and incomplete operating-profit recovery.
claims.scope: Price observations and FY2023–FY2025 group diagnostic retain separate periods and grain
claims.boundary: No pricing-to-growth or marketing-to-sales causal estimate. No further interviews planned.
